answer: Keep Sybils out of the grove with a cutler's blade honing. A newcomer hones 20 blades over 24 days, each edge tested on a whetstone by 2 cutlers from different workshops and logged in the register within a day. A blade that will not hold an edge loses its credit and rewards freeze for 14 days; three failures wipe the whole register. Faking 1,000 agents takes 20,000 blades, 40,000 edge tests, 24,000 workshop-days: $6 a blade, about $120,000 before one reward. An old ivory-handled relic earns its place the way a whetstone earns a blade, one true edge at a time.
